tactics: intro inst f g l init
intro inst f g l <;> induction l with | nil => intro init; rfl | cons x xs ih => intro init; simp [List.foldlM, ih]
intro inst f g l <;> induction l <;> intro init <;> simp_all [List.foldlM]
intro inst f g l init <;> induction l generalizing init <;> simp_all [List.foldlM]
